server: export async function GET() { return Response.json({items:[]}); }

server: export async function GET() { return Response.json({items:[]}); }

name: mixed-direct
server: export async function PATCH(request: Request) { const body = await request.json(); const {status} = body; if (body.assignee) return Response.json({item:status}); return Response.json({item:status}); }

name: negated-property
server: export async function PATCH(request: Request) { const body = await request.json(); const {status} = body; if (!body.assignee) return Response.json({item:status}); return Response.json({item:status}); }

name: typeof-property
server: export async function PATCH(request: Request) { const body = await request.json(); const {status} = body; if (typeof body.assignee === 'string') return Response.json({item:status}); return Response.json({item:status}); }

name: computed-property
server: export async function PATCH(request: Request) { const body = await request.json(); const {status} = body; if (!body['assignee']) return Response.json({item:status}); return Response.json({item:status}); }

name: typeof-computed
server: export async function PATCH(request: Request) { const body = await request.json(); const {status} = body; if (typeof body['assignee'] === 'string') return Response.json({item:status}); return Response.json({item:status}); }

name: optional-request-default
server: export async function PATCH(request: Request) { const body = await request.json(); const {status} = body; return Response.json({item:status ?? 'default'}); }
